newsitem.title: UK: UK manufacturers, distributors stocks rise in Q1.
newsitem.headline: UK manufacturers, distributors stocks rise in Q1.

text.p: The level of total stocks in Britain's production, construction and distribution industries in the first quarter rose a revised 1.290 billion stg, the Office for National Statistics said on Monday.
Stocks rose by 1.756 billion in the previous quarter.
Manufacturers increased total stocks by 148 million stg during the first quarter, following a rise of 124 million in the fourth quarter of 1996.
Mining and quarrying stocks rose by 58 million in the first quarter after an increase of 10 million in Q4.
Materials, stores and fuels rose by 129 million stg compared with a fourth quarter rise of 127 million.
Work in progress rose by 152 million stg following a decrease of 134 million in the previous quarter.
Finished goods stocks fell by 133 million stg in Q1 having risen 131 million in Q4.
